case.summary: The customer reported a $49.00 purchase they said they never made. The investigation found the same $49.00 charge on two earlier dates and that the billing region is routine for the card, indicating it is a genuine customer transaction. The customer confirmed the charge is part of their recurring purchase after being shown the earlier identical charges. The case was closed as legitimate and the customer was warned about the recurring charge. No further action is required.
